alert: Loom step slots idle with work waiting

A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint,
           any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host,
           any(lower(JSONExtractString(labels, 'repo'))) AS repo,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'role')) AS role,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'pool')) AS pool
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name IN ('loom.step.actionable', 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  pts AS (
    SELECT series.host AS host, series.repo AS repo, series.role AS role, series.pool AS pool,
           s.metric_name AS metric, s.unix_milli AS ms, s.value AS value
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name IN ('loom.step.actionable', 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
      AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
      AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
  ),
  host_repos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT host, repo
    FROM pts
    WHERE metric = 'loom.step.actionable' AND host != '' AND repo != ''
  ),
  repo_depth_at AS (
    SELECT repo, intDiv(ms, 60000) AS minute, max(value) AS depth
    FROM pts
    WHERE metric = 'loom.step.actionable' AND repo != ''
    GROUP BY repo, minute
  ),
  repo_depth AS (
    SELECT repo, min(depth) AS min_depth, argMax(depth, minute) AS last_depth,
           min(minute) AS first_minute
    FROM repo_depth_at
    GROUP BY repo
  ),
  host_slots AS (
    SELECT host,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots' AND role = 'sweep' AND pool = '') AS busy_max,
           argMaxIf(value, ms, metric = 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots' AND role = 'sweep' AND pool = '') AS busy_last,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent') AS max_concurrent
    FROM pts
    WHERE host != '' AND metric != 'loom.step.actionable'
    GROUP BY host
  ),
  repo_slots AS (
    SELECT host_repos.repo AS repo,
           countIf(host_slots.busy_last < host_slots.max_concurrent) AS hosts_with_free_slots,
           max(host_slots.busy_max / host_slots.max_concurrent) AS best_fill
    FROM host_repos
    INNER JOIN host_slots ON host_slots.host = host_repos.host
    WHERE host_slots.max_concurrent > 0
    GROUP BY repo
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       repo_slots.repo AS repo,
       repo_slots.best_fill AS value
FROM repo_slots
INNER JOIN repo_depth ON repo_depth.repo = repo_slots.repo
WHERE repo_depth.min_depth > 0
  AND repo_depth.first_minute <= intDiv({{.start_timestamp_ms}}, 60000) + 5
ORDER BY repo

annotations.summary: Loom step slots idle with work waiting
annotations.description: Repo {{$labels.repo}} had drawable items (loom.step.actionable > 0) in every tick of the last 30 min, but the busiest host dispatching for it never filled more than {{$value}} of its slots (loom.dispatch.busy_slots role=sweep over loom.dispatch.max_concurrent). Look at pick.decision item_draw refused_* counts and loom.dispatch.step refusals for the repo. Issue rjwalters/loom#11909.
